correctness.rationale: Finite-state Moran transition probabilities include null updates and both absorbing outcomes. Exact first-event equations for fixation-weighted first and second moments were independently replayed on current package files. Full symbolic rational-function analysis of the only nonsymmetric three-vertex graph gives strictly negative center-versus-leaf differences for all \(r>0\); complete, edge and triangle cases are symmetric. Two exact rational implementations confirm the four-vertex diamond conditional mean and variance inequalities at \(r=5\), using different conditioning methods.

originality.rationale: Full-text comparison shows that the closest 2014 study covers the same diamond topology and conditional mean fixation times but not conditional variance optimization. The 2015 exact numerical technique derives mean times but does not state the competing second-moment rankings; the 2015 distribution paper and 2018 large-graph paper treat count-lumpable structures, not this four-site diamond. Exact seed-wise rational inequalities and the all-fitness three-site lower bound were independently checked. This is best-knowledge originality with residual priority risks.

value.rationale: The smallest population size at which mean-optimal and uncertainty-optimal successful mutant seed sites conflict is a natural structural property of the classic Moran process. It sharpens the distinction between expected time and variability in evolutionary sweeps on heterogeneous networks, rather than merely reproducing a known mean-time graph or arbitrary parameter table. The counterexample is strict, stable under a neighborhood of fitness values, and has an exact universal lower bound.
